metadata.title: Explaining the Links Between School Administrator Leadership, Job Satisfaction, and Participatory School Climate: A Machine Learning-Enhanced Multilevel Analysis of TALIS 2024 School Administrator Data

design_fields.q1_rationale: Plausible values are not applicable because the dependent variable is a TALIS composite scale score rather than a PV-based cognitive achievement score.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that TALIS survey weights and the full complex sampling design were not incorporated, indicating that the analysis was not weighted.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study used multilevel linear mixed models, which consider clustering at the national level.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study performed internal validation using bootstrap confidence intervals, indicating that it did not validate findings on an external dataset.
